gates.text: A requestor cannot approve their own hiring request
A report approver cannot also issue that report
A person cannot approve their own expense voucher
Accepted (Hired) and Joined are genuinely different
A Back-office hire is not a deployable field inspector
The system asked what kind of team member — never silently chose Field
Hiring one person does not close a multi-vacancy requisition
The same work cannot be invoiced twice
An issued report cannot be edited
Signed-out users reach no business screen
An inspector cannot reach candidates, invoices or admin
Record numbers in the address bar expose nothing
No screen showed SQLSTATE, PDOException or Fatal error
